svg.title: Dataflow Gen2 Low-Code Transformation Flow
svg.desc: Source connectors feed Power Query transformations. Dataflow Gen2 uses managed Fabric SQL staging for scale-out processing, writes one or more destinations, and can run as a pipeline activity with monitoring.
svg.text: Dataflow Gen2 — Power Query ETL in Microsoft Fabric
Shared engine: Excel · Power BI · Power Platform · Dynamics 365
connect · transform · generate samples · undo via prompts
Each step recorded as M formula in Applied Steps
Each query can route to an independent destination table or file

g.title: Source connectors — Dataflow Gen2 connects Power Query to Fabric, cloud, and on-premises sources.
Power Query shaping — Authors define joins, cleansing, types, and aggregations as applied steps.
Managed SQL staging — Fabric provisions internal staging items for scale-out Dataflow processing.
Configured destinations — One dataflow can write transformed output to multiple Fabric or external destinations.
Pipeline orchestration — A pipeline schedules the dataflow and coordinates downstream activities.
